title: Flimsy
text:
Flimsy. Don’t think they are good for sliding on a shelf they aren’t the best on staying sturdy with too much in it. And by too much it’s not very much in it with out it bending and taking up space where ever it’s hanging from.

I still use them for my fridge I just don’t slide them in because my fridges shelves are too thick for it and so are my pantry shelves. They don’t seem to thick but they are for these.

product_metadata.title: Fridge Drawer Organizer 4 Pack Retractable Drawer Refrigerator Storage Box,Unique Design Pull Out Bins, Fridge Shelf Holder Storage Box, Small Size, FIT FOR Under 0.5'' Fridge Shelf
features: FIT FOR 0.5'' Under Fridge Shelf:Before buying, please carefully understand whether the size of your refrigerator partition is less than 0.5 inches/1.4 cm in width to ensure that our products are fit onto your fridge shelves. Thank you!

Keeping things fresh:The ventilation holes at the bottom of the refrigerator drawer organizer facilitate drainage and ventilation, The ventilation holes that help in keeping things fresh. If I need to close the holes for some reason I just use a paper towel beneath.
Unique Design: The hanging refrigerator rack effectively utilizes the upper gap of the refrigerator, increasing storage space to accommodate more food.Please note!
Note: If you use the extension of the refrigerator shelf, you better put light items in it to avoid damage.
